scenario: The ego vehicle travels on a multi-lane urban road and changes lanes to overtake a bus that is stopping or moving slowly.

ego.behavior: The car travels straight forward, signals left, changes into the left lane to overtake a bus, then returns to the right lane and continues forward.

adversarials.behavior: The truck travels straight forward in the left lane ahead of the ego vehicle.
The car travels straight forward in the left lane ahead of the ego vehicle.
The bus travels forward in the right lane, slows down or stops, and is overtaken by the ego vehicle.

spatial_relation: The ego vehicle is on a multi-lane straight urban road with a bus in the same lane ahead, a truck in the left lane ahead, and a car also in the left lane; a pedestrian overpass spans the road, and buildings and fences line both sides.
requirements_and_restrictions: The ego vehicle must maintain safe following distance from the bus before initiating the lane change, and the scenario terminates once the ego has completed the overtaking maneuver and returned to the right lane.

road_side_structures.position: Positioned on the right side of the road near the pedestrian overpass.

reasoning_chain: 1. Actors: Ego is the dashboard-camera car; adversarials are the truck, car, and bus. 2. Enumeration: three adversarials. 3. Chronology: initially ego follows bus in right lane with truck and car in left lane; midpoint ego signals left and changes lane to overtake bus; ending ego passes bus and returns to right lane. 4. Evidence: bus visibly slows and shifts to right side of frame; ego's lateral position moves left then back right; truck and car maintain forward trajectories in left lane.
